sourceReview.interpretation: OSM conditional maxspeed keys describe speed changes when conditions hold. Our static no-departure interpretation chooses the minimum of the existing base modeled speed and every supported numeric stated conditional speed for that direction. This conservative model envelope is our inference, not a mandated OSM algorithm or proof of legal speed for every situation.

hypothesis: Blanket closure of any conditional tag unnecessarily excludes roads whose only applicable conditional rule changes a parseable positive numeric speed. Keep availability at a static lower speed envelope instead of closing those ways. This is an availability policy experiment, not a global factor calibration.
parser: Bounded UTF-8 source strings; 65536-character limit, 64 clauses, parenthesis depth8; split semicolons only outside parentheses, one @ per clause and nonempty opaque conditions. Use unchanged numeric km/h/mph parser and >0 <=160km/h limits. Conditions are not evaluated or classified; all stated values contribute to the minimum. Unknown keys, values, quotes, malformed splitting/empty conditions retain the original closure.
preserved: Canonical foot/bicycle/hgv-only scope correction; all other access/oneway/lane/unknown/relation/node constraints; exact old positive speeds/directions/defaults/signals/tagged anchors/source tags. No place, coordinate or route-specific rule.
acceptance: All17 controls pass; complete captured source counts/old-positive retention; source fullSHA/stat before/after unchanged; preserve every candidate including unsupported/still-excluded records. No national, native, graph connectivity, ETA, physical, accuracy, app or deployment acceptance implied.

resources.scope: Host deadline/RSS checks only; no cgroup/CPU/swap admission.
